what: A chord performance synth with a low split: chords in a groove on the right and a bass arp on the left, or a scale-locked lead over chords. Seven sounds after classic synths (Juno-106 poly and pad, Oberheim brass, DX7 electric piano and bell, Minimoog bass and lead), twenty chord sets by mood plus five secret ones, a sidechain for the kick, MIDI clock in over USB (another FM-1 as well), and CHORD MAN, an arcade game that rewards playing in time.
author: swtdr34mz
